services.name: Group Fitness
services.desc: This 60-minute barbell program strengthens all your major muscles in an inspiring, motivating group environment with fantastic music and awesome instructors. With simple, athletic movements such as squats, lunges, presses, and curls, Group Power is for all ages and fitness levels. Perfect for everybody and anybody! Zumba® classes take the "work" out of a workout in a dance fitness party combining cardio, conditioning, balance, and flexibility. The Alaska Club has a wide variety of group cardio classes including Group Cycle, Group Blast - a fun endurance workout using a step, INSANITY taking you to new training heights, P90X - a total body strength and cardio conditioning, and Tread & Shred

services.name: Nordic Spa
services.desc: Discover a new way to relax, recover, and recharge at The Alaska Club’s Nordic Spa, Anchorage’s most accessible and inviting hot-and-cold therapy experience. Designed for everyday wellness, our Nordic Spa in Alaska offers a combination of restorative spaces you can use to create a simple routine that supports your physical and mental well-being. Whether you’re unwinding after a workout or giving yourself some well-deserved me time with a unique self-care experience, the Nordic Spa at The Alaska Club offers a luxurious yet approachable escape in the heart of Anchorage. Our Alaska Nordic Spa is a holistic experience built around contrast therapy, a cycle of moving between hot, cold, and rest.

services.desc: Starfish Academy is The Alaska Club’s branded swim lesson program and the most comprehensive multilocation option for families seeking swim lessons in Anchorage, Eagle River, Fairbanks and Wasilla. With five convenient locations, our program makes it easy for families across Alaska to access high-quality swimming classes in a welcoming, safety-focused environment. Members and non-members are welcome to participate, and new sessions begin every month. Registration for the upcoming session opens on the 15th of the previous month, giving parents plenty of time to plan.
